what: Base clean bootstrap (Seg281, last_model of the just-finished chunk): 2x2 identity split + sector-gain dose response

readings.no_measurable_identity: fs_sector +1.2e-5 (positive, wrong sign) is smaller than its own permutation null (1.5e-5); fs_size -9.5e-6 is ~2x its null (4.8e-6); nothing is above the real floor
readings.floor_is_not_the_null: the same 'both-shuffled' quantity measured twice differs by 2.7e-5 (ablation -4.0e-5 vs decompose b1 -1.4e-5), i.e. run-to-run instability ~3e-5 is 15x the permutation null (1.8e-6); the permutation null alone understates the floor for this model
readings.no_sector_kick: an 8x sector gain moves fs_sector not at all (noise) and CE by only -2.5e-5 (alpha=4), so the sector vector behaves like a small bias correction, not an identity channel
readings.efficiency_vs_small: at alpha=8 the relative injection is 1.34e-3 (vs Small 3.32e-3) and fs_sector stays ~2e-5 => identity per unit relative injection ~0.015 vs Small 0.168, i.e. ~11x weaker
readings.caveat: Base delta 0.0084 is below Small's earliest measurable point (0.0167 at cum 516), so there is no Small reference at this stage; 'not shaped' and 'not yet shaped' are indistinguishable without that point
